result.instructions: Tools for SugarCRM, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "List the Opportunities closing this month, largest amount first."; "Find every Account whose name starts with Acme and show its phone and website."; "Count the open Cases assigned to me.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes SugarCRM data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run sugarcrm_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run sugarcrm_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run sugarcrm_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. sugarcrm_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: sugarcrm_list_records
tools.title: List records
tools.description: List records of one module (Accounts, Contacts, Leads, Opportunities, Cases, or a custom module), newest page first by the sort you set. Returns records and next_offset (-1 when no more). SugarCRM API: GET /rest/v11_21/:module.

fields.description: Comma-separated field names to return, e.g. id,name,date_entered.

offset.description: Offset for paging. Use the next_offset from the last reply.

tools.name: sugarcrm_get_record
tools.title: Get a record
tools.description: Get one record by id, with the fields you ask for. SugarCRM API: GET /rest/v11_21/:module/:id.

fields.description: Comma-separated field names to return, e.g. id,name,date_entered.

tools.name: sugarcrm_filter_records
tools.title: Filter records
tools.description: Find records of one module with a Sugar filter array. Read-only: it sends the filter in the body of a POST. Returns records and next_offset. SugarCRM API: POST /rest/v11_21/:module/filter.

fields.description: Comma-separated field names to return, e.g. id,name,date_entered.

offset.description: Offset for paging. Use the next_offset from the last reply.

tools.name: sugarcrm_count_records
tools.title: Count records
tools.description: Count the records of one module that match a Sugar filter array. SugarCRM API: POST /rest/v11_21/:module/filter/count.

tools.name: sugarcrm_get_enum_values
tools.title: Get dropdown values
tools.description: List the allowed values of a dropdown field on a module, e.g. Opportunities sales_stage. SugarCRM API: GET /rest/v11_21/:module/enum/:field.

tools.name: sugarcrm_create_record
tools.title: Create a record
tools.description: Create one record in a module with the field values you give. Writes data to the customer's Sugar. SugarCRM API: POST /rest/v11_21/:module.

data.description: Field values to set, e.g. {"name": "Acme Ltd"}.

tools.name: sugarcrm_update_record
tools.title: Update a record
tools.description: Update the field values you give on one existing record. Fields you leave out keep their values. Changes live data in the customer's Sugar. SugarCRM API: PUT /rest/v11_21/:module/:id.

data.description: Field values to set, e.g. {"name": "Acme Ltd"}.
